Video Compressor

Shrink a video file by re-encoding it at a lower bitrate. Pick Low, Medium or High quality and compare the original and new file sizes.

Re-encodes to WebM at a lower bitrate. Your file never leaves your device.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a video file from your device.
  2. Pick a quality level: Low, Medium or High.
  3. Click "Compress Video" and wait while it is re-encoded.
  4. Compare the original and compressed sizes, then download the smaller file.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What do the quality settings mean?

Low targets about 0.5 Mbps (max 640 px wide), Medium about 1.5 Mbps (max 1280 px) and High about 3 Mbps (up to 1920 px). Output is WebM, or MP4 on Safari.

Will the compressed video look much worse?

Re-encoding always involves some quality trade-off, but Medium and High stay visually close to the original for most footage.

Is my video uploaded anywhere?

Yes — the video is re-encoded locally on your device and never uploaded anywhere.
